changed: Task presets now come from the domain pack (R-3). e_agent.sdk.ports gains TaskPreset (kind, the demo prompt with its default refs written out, the default refs in the order overrides apply, help; an empty default is refused) and PluginContribution.task_presets. TaskPreset.render applies (ref, value) overrides one after another by text replacement, which is the old CLI algorithm. PluginRegistry collects presets by kind and refuses two different definitions of one kind with STARTUP_REJECTED (PR-09). The ERP domain pack contributes the eight presets that were TASK_PROMPTS in server/cli.py and TASK_KINDS/DEFAULT_REFS in erp/testing/scripted_tasks.py; all eight share one ref table (TASK_REFS) in the old DEFAULT_REFS order plus demand_ref, and the scripted driver's TASK_KINDS and DEFAULT_REFS derive from them. DriverConfig.task_kind is a plain string with no ERP wording; bootstrap refuses a kind no admitted plugin offers, naming the admitted kinds. cli.demo_prompt applies the top-level demand_ref/product_ref, then refs in table order, skipping refs.demand_ref as before; --task has no static choices. qualify_model.py and capture_model_replays.py take prompts from the presets. Behaviour equality: a 72-case golden of the CLI's own demo path (8 kinds plus the profile default, under 8 profiles) recorded on unchanged code (36 cases at 49abd0b; 36 collision cases recorded on a 59dbb9c worktree with every e_agent module asserted to load from it), and an oracle test comparing cli.demo_prompt with the 59dbb9c algorithm, copied with frozen constants, over every pair of colliding overrides for all eight kinds. Codex review (harness/state/1/reviews/1d.3.json, rework): R-1 fixed in 93184fb: sequential replacement with one shared ref table; refs.demand_ref skipped as before. Red first: at 5b793e8 test_cli_demo_prompts_unchanged failed with 11 of 72 golden cases different (chain/amend-rfq, collide/quotation, legacy-default/* x5, refs-demand/* x4) and test_demo_prompt_matches_baseline_for_colliding_overrides failed with AttributeError: module 'e_agent.server.cli' has no attribute 'demo_prompt'; green after the fix (18 passed). R-2 fixed in 93184fb: no format template remains; render cannot raise on any prompt; an empty default is refused at construction (test_empty_default_refused). R-3 evidence supplied: first round, the new tests were run before any implementation and failed at collection with ImportError: cannot import name 'TaskPreset' from 'e_agent.sdk.ports' (2 errors; the plan expected AttributeError: task_presets, same cause); second round recorded above under R-1.
